Describe the behavior, expected result and minimal reproduction.

Include CodeSlot, WordPress, PHP, server and SAPI versions, theme and relevant plugins. State whether Safe Mode or a page cache changes the result.

Attach sanitized logs and actual test results. Never include credentials or private executable snippets. Report security issues privately; see SECURITY.md.
